review_candidates.description: Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Live events don't wait for business hours. The captures start at 6 p.m. Central European Time, most of them are US sports and events, and every one needs a human to press record. Right now that's three people in Poland and one in the US, and they're good. But contractors take days off, and every time they do, there's a hole in the schedule: weekend nights, mostly. The volume of live events is going up, and the bench has to grow with it. What you'd actually do You start the live captures and then you watch them. When something breaks (the player stops, a VPN drops on our servers, the stream buffers), an alert fires and you fix it, following our internal guidelines. No one is awake at 3 a.m. to hold your hand, so you learn the guidelines properly. It's easier than it sounds until a live event is on the line. Live events have a lot of rules, and missing one costs us the capture. Between live events you handle long-form recordings: capturing on-demand content, editing the video when it needs it, running quality checks against our rules, and ingesting it into our database. You'll work in our own web apps, jump onto remote machines, and use spreadsheets. Nobody arrives already knowing our platform, because you can't hire for it on the market. We teach it. What you need to already be good at English you can work in every day. It's the one hard requirement. Comfortable with computers: remote machines, spreadsheets, learning new web tools fast. review_candidates.description: Description The Supercritical Mission This September the UN stopped hedging: the world will overshoot 1.5°C of warming, and carbon removal, alongside deep emissions cuts, is essential to coming back. The math is stark. The world needs to remove roughly 10 billion tonnes of CO₂ a year by 2050, and all the permanent removal ever delivered adds up to fewer than 2 million tonnes, less than a single day of that future run rate. An industry Swiss Re calls the next trillion-dollar market has to be built from scratch in under three decades. Supercritical exists to build it. Our mission: scale carbon removal to gigatonnes by building the connective infrastructure for the market. As the #1 carbon removal marketplace we source, create, and guarantee permanent supply for the world’s most demanding buyers. Nearly 2 million tonnes facilitated for 200+ corporate buyers. A science team that helps set the SBTi standards the market will be measured against. More than 300,000 tonnes delivered and retired with zero missed retirements, and the largest biochar offtake in US history, 1 million tonnes over 10 years, created for Microsoft. Why Carbon Removal, Why Now? Carbon removal is not carbon avoidance. A carbon removal credit is one tonne of CO₂ physically taken out of the atmosphere and stored permanently. One tonne emitted plus one tonne removed equals net zero; no other route produces a credible claim. And demand is no longer voluntary goodwill: SBTi’s Net-Zero Standard now sets interim removal targets on the path to net zero, disclosure rules are switching on across major markets, and the AI economy is already buying, with Google, Amazon, Stripe, and Anthropic all purchasing carbon removal and Microsoft behind the largest biochar offtake in history. This market gets built in the next three decades, by the people who show up early. The role Our suppliers are at the heart of what we offer the world's most demanding carbon removal buyers. As Supply Account Manager, you'll own Supercritical's relationships with every supplier across the world once they’ve contracted with us: our exclusive and non-exclusive projects, the suppliers behind the offtakes and deals we've sold, and the early-stage projects moving through our Supply Development Programme. This is a stakeholder management role, inside and outside the business. You'll onboard each supplier and be their point of contact through development, delivery, review and renewal, building relationships strong enough to handle every conversation, from a new deal to a missed milestone. You'll run the regular rhythm, from check-ins to QBRs, know each project inside out, and coordinate our supply, sales, marketing and climate science teams so both sides deliver. You'll also keep us on top of our commitments. You'll be accountable for delivery against contracted milestones, own credit retirement end to end, and maintain each supplier's risk and compliance record so sales always knows what's ready to allocate. When something slips, you'll be the first to know and will make sure the right people hear about it fast. HubSpot is our single source of truth, and you'll help shape the automated workflows that keep routine updates moving, so your time goes on the relationships that matter most. Key responsibilities: Supplier relationships: be the single owner of the relationship for every signed supplier, from onboarding through to renewal or exit, engaging stakeholders up to founder and CEO level. Account management: own the terms of every signed supply contract, with accountability for supplier delivery against contracted milestones. Run QBRs and annual reviews according to supplier tier, and own supplier reporting, tracking NPS and performance KPIs. Supplier Workflow management: own supplier workflows across the lifecycle, from credit retirement to maintaining each supplier's risk register, compliance record and current rating, and confirming when a supplier is ready for allocation. Project development: guide new projects through our supply development programme, owning the development plan and managing internal and external stakeholders through to project launch. Requirements Who you are Experienced account manager. You have a proven account management background (3-5 years as an Account Manager), including managing international stakeholders and projects across different countries and time zones. You hold your own with senior stakeholders, whether the news is good or bad. People trust you because you're direct and you follow through. Systems thinker. You've set up CRM processes and automated workflows before (HubSpot experience is a plus), and you instinctively look for ways to make a process run without you having to chase it. Commercially sharp. You're comfortable talking pipeline, contracts and delivery, and you can build a clear, data-backed case for why a supplier should keep growing with us. Organised. You're highly organised with impeccable attention to detail. You can hold a portfolio of accounts, contract terms and delivery dates in your head at once, and you spot problems before they land. Start-up experience. You've worked in a start-up or scale-up and you know what that means day to day. This role is still taking shape, you ramp up quickly, and you enjoy defining how things should be done rather than inheriting a playbook. Experience in carbon removal, climate, agriculture or commodity supply chains is a bonus, not a requirement. Most of all, you’re excited to work on the world’s most important problem with a friendly and motivated team. What values can you expect from your colleagues? We have set ourselves the mission of leading the carbon removal market to 14,000x its current size by 2050. In order to do that we need brave adventurers that think huge and deliver at speed. We call this the 14,000x mindset. The key components of the 14,000x mindset are: Ownership mentality: We relish autonomy and we create it for others. We are deeply curious and thrive on understanding the root cause of complex problems. We take ownership over our own and our team’s development by giving and soliciting direct and actionable feedback. Move fast: We identify the most important problems to solve and cut everything else. We test ideas early so we don’t waste time on dead ends. We default to action and deliver awesome results. Radiate positive energy: We come to problems with energy and passion. We nurture new ideas and engage positively in testing them. We inspire our colleagues to go further and are resilient to setbacks. We recharge by taking time off. We are here for a great day, not a long day. Communicate proactively: We communicate simply and directly. We broadcast updates, insights and lessons learned, especially when things haven’t gone to plan. We give as much context as possible so our teammates can make great decisions. Benefits Basic salary: £55,000–£65,000 per annum, dependent on experience Unlimited Annual Leave – Take the time you need to recharge Extra Time Off – The first Friday of every month is a company-wide day off Pension Contribution – We’ll match your 5% contribution with 3% Flexible Hybrid Work – Work remotely first, with the option to use our London office in Work.life Old Street Wellbeing & Home Setup Support – £1,000 annual wellbeing allowance + up to £500 for home office equipment Team Socials – Monthly team socials and quarterly company gatherings in London and annual company multi-day offsites. Diversity and Inclusion We’ve been committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace since day one of the company. We’re the only company we’re aware of with a 50:50 gender balanced list of investors and our day to day processes are always defined with D&I in mind, for example our remote first policy and flexibility around working time. We are excited to encourage applications and interest from individuals underrepresented in the climate and tech space. Climate change and climate justice is a social issue that cuts across race and gender. We welcome applicants with lived experience across these issues. Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. UK Sponsorship & Applicants currently outside the UK UK Work Sponsorship: Unfortunately, at this stage of our growth, we are unable to offer UK sponsorship to applicants.
